title: KPI record
description: One extracted KPI value: a single metric for one company and fiscal year. python-worker writes it to Azure SQL (upsert key: company + fiscal_year + metric) and node-api reads it. value is null when the metric was not found in the report; a value is never guessed.

company.description: Company stock ticker, upper case (e.g. AAPL).

value.description: unit 'currency': amount in full currency units (1234500000, not 'in millions'). unit 'ratio': a fraction (0.315 means 31.5%). null when not found.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for unit 'currency'. Always null for unit 'ratio'.

source_page.description: 1-based PDF page the value was taken from. Required when value is set and null when value is null.

document_id.description: Document the value was extracted from (same as document_id in the ingestion queue message).

extracted_at.description: When the value was extracted (RFC 3339, UTC).
